result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback position by preserving Customer’s convenience-termination right, capping early-termination charges at three months’ charges, and refunding prepaid amounts attributable to post-termination periods. It does not create a Vendor convenience-termination right. The changes are targeted and preserve the original scope and prerequisite-attachment limitation. Drafting is generally professional, though the refund could more expressly state that it is pro rata, and the month-end requirement means the notice period is not always exactly 30 days.
